sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七个床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最棒的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我非常喜欢一锅出食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮您理解世界并充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，访问 nytimes.com 旁边的 slash 订阅获取特惠。

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: It is my second day here at the National Quarantine Unit in Omaha, Nebraska.
sentences.zh: 这是我在内布拉斯加州奥马哈市国家隔离检疫单位的第二天。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to give you a little tour of my room.
sentences.zh: 我只是想带大家简单参观一下我的房间。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Balbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: So this is the door where I've only entered once because I will not be exiting.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我只进来过一次的门，因为我不会离开这里。

sentences.en: Inside a hospital in Nebraska, 16 Americans who have been exposed to the HUNTA virus aboard
sentences.zh: 在内布拉斯加州的一家医院里，16名在邮轮上接触过汉坦病毒的美国人

sentences.en: a cruise ship have begun an unusually long quarantine that in some cases will last up to 42 days.
sentences.zh: 已经开始了一场异常漫长的隔离，在某些情况下，隔离时间最长可达42天。

sentences.en: This is the one bag that I was able to bring.
sentences.zh: 这是我唯一能带上的包。

sentences.en: And I shoved socks, underwear, shorts, and things throughout the bag where I had space.
sentences.zh: 我在包里有空间的地方塞满了袜子、内衣、短裤和其他东西。

sentences.en: I prioritized my electronics, my camera.
sentences.zh: 我把电子产品和相机放在了优先位置。

sentences.en: Medical officials say that precaution is required to protect the public from a little-understood disease that has already proven highly fatal to those on board the ship.
sentences.zh: 医疗官员表示，为了保护公众免受这种人们知之甚少、且已被证明对船上人员具有高度致死性的疾病侵害，这些预防措施是必要的。

sentences.en: So my thought is, I know that if anything were to happen, I can't foresee there being anywhere else to have better medical care for this specific illness than being here.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，我知道如果发生任何事，我无法想象还有什么地方能比这里为这种特殊疾病提供更好的医疗护理。

sentences.en: Today, Apoorva Mondavili on what we're learning about that outbreak, the virus behind it, and how a public health system still reeling from COVID responded to the crisis.
sentences.zh: 今天，阿波尔瓦·曼达维利将为我们讲述我们目前对这次疫情、其背后的病毒，以及一个仍在从新冠疫情中恢复的公共卫生系统如何应对这场危机的新了解。

sentences.en: Now I have to put on my mask so I can show the nurses that my comfort is all good.
sentences.zh: 现在我得戴上口罩，好向护士展示我的身体状况一切都好。

sentences.en: It's Friday, May 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月15日，星期五。

sentences.en: Apoorva, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 阿波尔瓦，欢迎回到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 非常荣幸。

sentences.en: It feels like in our post-COVID world, where every virus that you hear about inevitably resurrects the ghosts of the pandemic, this latest outbreak on a ship, that this has really
sentences.zh: 在我们的后新冠时代，感觉你听说的每一个病毒都不可避免地唤起了大流行的幽灵，而这次在船上的最新疫情，真的

sentences.en: consumed all of our imaginations and kept a few of us up at night.
sentences.zh: 占据了我们所有的想象力，让我们当中好几个人彻夜难眠。

sentences.en: Understandably.
sentences.zh: 可以理解。

sentences.en: I mean, as you mentioned, the ship, but also a virus that most of us have not really spent much time thinking about.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如你所提到的，不仅是那艘船，还有一种我们大多数人都没怎么花时间去思考的病毒。

sentences.en: And we're hearing about people getting sick one after the other.
sentences.zh: 而且我们听到人们一个接一个地生病。

sentences.en: The numbers are going up.
sentences.zh: 数字正在上升。

sentences.en: We're hearing all those words, quarantine, isolation, contact tracing, death.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了所有这些词：隔离、检疫、接触者追踪、死亡。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we have PTSD, many of us, from having dealt with COVID.
sentences.zh: 而且我们许多人在应对过新冠之后，都有了创伤后应激障碍。

sentences.en: So yeah, I'm getting a lot of panicked messages from friends and family.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我收到了很多来自朋友和家人的恐慌信息。

sentences.en: My son, my daughter's best friend, freaking out.
sentences.zh: 我儿子、我女儿的最好朋友，都吓坏了。

sentences.en: Is this the next pandemic?
sentences.zh: 这是下一场大流行吗？

sentences.en: Are we all going to die?
sentences.zh: 我们都要死了吗？

sentences.en: You give too many people your cell phone.
sentences.zh: 你把手机号给太多人了。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: And what do you tell these people when they reach out to you over the past two weeks about what began on this ship?
sentences.zh: 当过去两周这些人就这艘船上开始的事情联系你时，你是怎么对他们说的？

sentences.en: I have said consistently the same thing over the past two weeks, which is this is not the next pandemic.
sentences.zh: 过去两周我一直重复着同样的话，那就是这不是下一场大流行。

sentences.en: And I say that because we may not know a ton about this virus, but we know enough to know that it does not spread easily.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是因，为我们可能对这种病毒了解不多，但我们了解得足够多，知道它不易传播。

sentences.en: It's not super contagious.
sentences.zh: 它不是超级具传染性的。

sentences.en: And in fact, this is the only kind of this hantavirus that even spreads among people at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是这种汉坦病毒中唯一一种甚至能在人与人之间传播的病毒。

sentences.en: And so there are just a lot of signs from what we know so far that do indicate that this thing is going to stay contained.
sentences.zh: 因此，从我们目前所知的情况来看，有很多迹象表明这件事会得到控制。

sentences.en: But I don't want to minimize the fact that we have had 11 cases so far, three deaths, and there will probably be more cases.
sentences.zh: 但我不想淡化这样一个事实：目前我们已经有了11个病例、3起死亡病例，而且可能会有更多病例。

sentences.en: And this is a serious outbreak and it's a serious disease.
sentences.zh: 这是一场严重的疫情，也是一种严重的疾病。

sentences.en: There's a very high fatality rate once people do get sick.
sentences.zh: 人们一旦生病，其病死率非常高。

sentences.en: And so the experts I talk to are worried, but they're worried mainly for the people on the ship, not for the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 所以我交谈过的专家们都很担心，但他们主要是为船上的人担心，而不是为我们其他人担心。

sentences.en: And they are also sort of relieved that this outbreak happened on a cruise ship because it means that it's a lot easier to track all of those folks and to contain
sentences.zh: 他们也某种程度上感到庆幸，这次疫情发生在一艘邮轮上，这意味着追踪所有人并控制疫情要容易得多

sentences.en: the outbreak, which they're doing right now.
sentences.zh: 而他们现在正在这样做。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: I don't think of that ship as being a lucky situation, but it sounds like in a way it was the best possible scenario for an outbreak like this.
sentences.zh: 我不认为那艘船是一个幸运的情况，但听起来在某种程度上，对于这样一场疫情来说，这是可能的最理想方案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: From a global perspective, if you want to have an outbreak, it's best to have it on an isolated cruise ship from where you can trace people.
sentences.zh: 从全球的角度来看，如果你非得有一场疫情，最好让它发生在一艘孤立的邮轮上，从那里你可以追踪到所有人。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that ordeal on that ship.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈船上的那场劫难吧。

sentences.en: With the benefit of a lot of reporting now that you and our colleagues have done, tell us as best you can the story of what happened
sentences.zh: 借助你和我们的同事现在做的大量报道，请尽可能为我们讲述那艘船上发生的事情的经过

sentences.en: on that ship with this virus and ultimately what it's taught us about this disease that a lot of us didn't really know much about until now.
sentences.zh: 这种病毒，以及它最终教会了我们什么关于这种疾病的知识，在此之前我们很多人其实对此知之甚少。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the cruise ship is designed for polar expeditions and it's set off from Ushuaia.
sentences.zh: 所以这艘邮轮是为极地探险设计的，它是从乌斯怀亚出发的。

sentences.en: I've been there.
sentences.zh: 我去过那里。

sentences.en: Actually, it's a gorgeous city.
sentences.zh: 其实，那是一座美丽的城市。

sentences.en: It's called literally the end of the world because it's the southernmost tip of the Americas.
sentences.zh: 它字面上的意思是世界的尽头，因为它是美洲的最南端。

sentences.en: And people set off on this cruise who were interested in things like birdwatching and looking at the animals that live in these kinds of conditions.
sentences.zh: 人们开始这次邮轮之旅，他们对观鸟以及观察生活在这些环境中的动物之类的事情感兴趣。

sentences.en: And this couple, this Dutch couple, we think, went birdwatching in a lot of different places in Argentina, in Chile, in Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这对夫妇，这对荷兰夫妇，在阿根廷、智利、乌拉圭的许多不同地方进行了观鸟。

sentences.en: And the World Health Organization is still trying to figure out exactly where in that process they might have become infected.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织仍在试图弄清楚他们在那个过程中的哪个具体环节可能被感染了。

sentences.en: But the current theory is that at least the husband and possibly the husband and the wife
sentences.zh: 但目前的理论是，至少丈夫，或者可能丈夫和妻子

sentences.en: got infected from a rodent and became infected with Andes virus, which is a kind of hantavirus, a species of hantavirus that's only found in Argentina.
sentences.zh: 被啮齿动物感染，并感染了安第斯病毒，这是一种汉坦病毒，一种仅在阿根廷发现的汉坦病毒物种。

sentences.en: And what's the working theory for how they would have gotten this virus from a rodent in
sentences.zh: 那么关于他们是如何在阿根廷从啮齿动物那里感染这种病毒的，

sentences.en: Argentina, like kind of logistically?
sentences.zh: 从后勤角度来看，目前的主流理论是什么？

sentences.en: Well, we don't know exactly how, but most likely they got it by being in touch with rodent droppings or with rodent urine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们不知道确切的过程，但最有可能的是他们通过接触啮齿动物的粪便或尿液而感染。

sentences.en: Maybe they touched an object that had those things on it and then they put their fingers in their mouth.
sentences.zh: 也许他们摸了沾有这些东西的物体，然后把手指放进了嘴里。

sentences.en: We don't know exactly how.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道确切的过程。

sentences.en: And Aporva, is this any old rodent or something quite specific?
sentences.zh: 阿波尔瓦，这是随便什么啮齿动物，还是某种非常特定的动物？

sentences.en: Something quite specific.
sentences.zh: 是非常特定的动物。

sentences.en: So in Argentina, it's from the long-tailed pygmy rat.
sentences.zh: 在阿根廷，它是从长尾侏儒鼠身上传染的。

sentences.en: And there are other rodents that may transmit it, but none of them are the mouse that you might see in your house.
sentences.zh: 还有其他可能会传播它的啮齿动物，但它们都不是你在家里可能会看到的老鼠。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay, so this couple is exposed, we think, to this virus, and now they're on this boat.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以这对夫妇被认为接触了这种病毒，现在他们在船上了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then the husband starts to feel a little sick.
sentences.zh: 然后丈夫开始觉得有点不舒服。

sentences.en: And then he starts to get sicker.
sentences.zh: 接着他开始病情加重。

sentences.en: And on April 11th, so 10 days after they've left Ushuaia, he dies.
sentences.zh: 在4月11日，也就是他们离开乌斯怀亚10天后，他去世了。

sentences.en: This is my sad beauty to inform you that one of our passengers suddenly passed away last night.
sentences.zh: 我很遗憾地通知大家，我们的一位乘客昨晚突然去世了。

sentences.en: And they make this announcement.
sentences.zh: 他们发表了这一声明。

sentences.en: They tell the other passengers that we have somebody on this boat who has died.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉其他乘客，我们船上有人去世了。

sentences.en: But, you know, no one panics because people do die on cruise ships sometimes.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，没有人恐慌，因为人们有时在邮轮上确实会去世。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this man was 70 and who knows what he died of.
sentences.zh: 而且这个人70岁了，谁知道他是因什么而死的。

sentences.en: Heart attack, stroke, whatever.
sentences.zh: 心脏病发作、中风，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so they continue on.
sentences.zh: 所以他们继续航行。

sentences.en: And also, remember, they're going through some very remote parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 而且，记住，他们正在穿过世界上一些非常偏远的地区。

sentences.en: They're in the middle of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 他们在海洋中央。

sentences.en: There's no land nearby.
sentences.zh: 附近没有陆地。

sentences.en: And so the body stays on the ship.
sentences.zh: 所以遗体留在了船上。

sentences.en: In the ship's morgue.
sentences.zh: 在船上的停尸房里。

sentences.en: In the ship's morgue.
sentences.zh: 在船上的停尸房里。

sentences.en: They continue on until April 24th.
sentences.zh: 他们继续航行直到4月24日。

sentences.en: They reach St. Helena, which is an island in the South
sentences.zh: 他们到达了圣赫勒拿岛，这是南大西洋上的一个

sentences.en: Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 岛屿。

sentences.en: And when they get there, that's when the body's taken off the ship.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达那里时，遗体才被带下船。

sentences.en: And the wife of this guy also disembarks along with another 30 or so people.
sentences.zh: 这个人的妻子以及其他大约30人也下了船。

sentences.en: And she then flies to Johannesburg in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 然后她飞往南非的约翰内斯堡。

sentences.en: She's Dutch.
sentences.zh: 她是荷兰人。

sentences.en: So she's trying to get on a flight from Johannesburg to Amsterdam then.
sentences.zh: 所以她当时正试图搭乘从约翰内斯堡飞往阿姆斯特丹的航班。

sentences.en: Gets so sick that she's made to get off the flight.
sentences.zh: 病情变得如此严重，以至于她被迫下了飞机。

sentences.en: She doesn't fly.
sentences.zh: 她没有飞行。

sentences.en: She stays in Johannesburg.
sentences.zh: 她留在了约翰内斯堡。

sentences.en: And she dies.
sentences.zh: 然后她去世了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The people on the ship also hear about her.
sentences.zh: 船上的人也听说了她的情况。

sentences.en: Now, a second person has died.
sentences.zh: 现在，第二个人去世了。

sentences.en: People on the boat understand that.
sentences.zh: 船上的人明白了这一点。

sentences.en: Do they start to get a little bit worried?
sentences.zh: 他们开始有点担心了吗？

sentences.en: Not yet, according to the people on the ship who have talked about this.
sentences.zh: 根据谈论过这件事的船上人员所说，还没有。

sentences.en: They didn't even really worry that much when a third person got sick and had to be taken off the ship.
sentences.zh: 当第三个人生病并不得不被带下船时，他们甚至没有真正感到那么担心。

sentences.en: You know, a medical evacuation on April 27th.
sentences.zh: 你知道，4月27日的医疗撤离。

sentences.en: They were still thinking, oh, maybe this is COVID.
sentences.zh: 他们当时还在想，哦，也许这是新冠。

sentences.en: Maybe this is a flu.
sentences.zh: 也许这是流感。

sentences.en: It could be so many other things.
sentences.zh: 可能是很多其他原因。

sentences.en: You know, it's like that old adage when you hear hoves think horses, not zebras.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像那句老话说的，当你听到蹄声时要想到马，而不是斑马。

sentences.en: No one's thinking zebra.
sentences.zh: 没有人想到斑马。

sentences.en: No one's thinking some weird hantavirus that no one's heard of.
sentences.zh: 没有人想到某种谁都没听说过的奇怪汉坦病毒。

sentences.en: But then as more people start to get sick, the ship's doctor gets sick and other patients get sick.
sentences.zh: 但随着越来越多的人开始生病，船上的医生生病了，其他病人也生病了。

sentences.en: And then most importantly, on April 28th, another person died.
sentences.zh: 然后最重要的是，在4月28日，又有一个人去世了。

sentences.en: The third passenger died.
sentences.zh: 第三位乘客去世了。

sentences.en: An 80-year-old German woman who had not had that much contact with the couple, as far as anyone can tell.
sentences.zh: 那是一位80岁的德国女性，据任何人所知，她与这对夫妇并没有太多接触。

sentences.en: That's when everyone starts to get worried.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，每个人都开始担心起来。

sentences.en: And then a few days later, on May 2nd, when you finally have a test saying that this is a hantavirus.
sentences.zh: 然后在几天后的5月2日，当你们终于得到检测结果确认这是汉坦病毒时。

sentences.en: This particular kind of hantavirus causes a very severe respiratory illness.
sentences.zh: 这种特定种类的汉坦病毒会导致非常严重的呼吸系统疾病。

sentences.en: Basically, people start out with symptoms that seem very much like the flu.
sentences.zh: 基本上，人们一开始的症状看起来非常像流感。

sentences.en: But then what they eventually die off is pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 但他们最终因之丧命的是肺炎。

sentences.en: Their lungs fill up with fluid and can also send their immune system into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 他们的肺部充满了液体，也可能导致他们的免疫系统进入过度运转状态。

sentences.en: And so that can actually be what kills the patient in the end.
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上可能是最终导致患者死亡的原因。

sentences.en: And are there any treatments?
sentences.zh: 有什么治疗方法吗？

sentences.en: Not yet.
sentences.zh: 还没有。

sentences.en: So at this point, with hantavirus confirmed on the ship...
sentences.zh: 因此，在这一点上，随着船上的汉坦病毒得到证实……

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us for this briefing on the hantavirus situation.
sentences.zh: 感谢您参加我们关于汉坦病毒情况的简报会。

sentences.en: That's when the World Health Organization gets involved.
sentences.zh: 这时候世界卫生组织就介入了。

sentences.en: Given the incubation period of the and this virus, which can be up to six weeks, it's possible that more cases may be reported.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这种病毒的潜伏期可达六周之久，可能会有更多的病例被通报。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, you have this more global event, and countries all around the world are paying attention.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这成了一起更加全球化的事件，世界各地的国家都开始关注。

sentences.en: This is when this story starts to really explode.
sentences.zh: 这个故事也就是从这个时候开始真正引爆的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Apoorva, as all this is happening, and the world is waking up to what's happening on this ship,
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦，随着这一切的发生，全世界都开始意识到这艘船上发生了什么，

sentences.en: what is the theory, especially in the public health world, places like WHO, about how these passengers are getting sick?
sentences.zh: 公共卫生界（比如世卫组织等机构）目前的主流理论是什么？大家认为这些乘客是怎么染病的？

sentences.en: I recall, very amateur hour over here, thinking, oh, there must be rodents on this ship.
sentences.zh: 我当时还像个外行一样瞎想，觉得“哦，这船上肯定有啮齿动物”。

sentences.en: I'm sure all ships have rodents.
sentences.zh: 我确信所有船上都有老鼠。

sentences.en: Is that what's going on?
sentences.zh: 是这么回事吗？

sentences.en: Well, that's not out of the question, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这也不是完全不可能，对吧？

sentences.en: They could have gotten it that way.
sentences.zh: 他们确实可能是通过这种方式感染的。

sentences.en: But as soon as scientists realized that this was the Andes virus species of hantavirus, for which we do know human-to-human transmission is possible,
sentences.zh: 但科学家们一发现这是汉坦病毒的安第斯病毒株——这种病毒我们确实知道可以在人与人之间传播——

sentences.en: they immediately started considering that as a possibility.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻就开始把这当作一种可能性来考虑。

sentences.en: That instead of all these people getting it from rodents on the ship, there was somebody who brought it on board, like, you know, the Dutch couple probably did now.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，这群人并非全是在船上从老鼠那里感染的，而是有人把它带上了船，就像现在那对荷兰夫妇可能做的那样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They could have been patients zero and one.
sentences.zh: 他们可能是零号病人和一号病人。

sentences.en: Zero and one.
sentences.zh: 零号和一号。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And that they may have then passed it on to everybody else.
sentences.zh: 然后他们可能把病毒传给了其他人。

sentences.en: And so that very quickly became a working theory.
sentences.zh: 所以这很快就成了主要的假设理论。

sentences.en: And the WHO and the European CDC and a Dutch official, you know, they were on board interviewing people trying to figure out what was happening.
sentences.zh: 世卫组织、欧洲疾控中心还有一名荷兰官员，他们都上了船去采访大家，试图弄清楚发生了什么。

sentences.en: And then finally, the WHO negotiates with the Spanish government to have the boat dock in the Canary Islands.
sentences.zh: 最后，世卫组织与西班牙政府谈判，让这艘船停靠在加那利群岛。

sentences.en: The passengers get off there and all of the health officials from various countries take the passengers to their countries, take them home for monitoring.
sentences.zh: 乘客们在那里下船，来自各国的卫生官员把各自国家的乘客接走，带回国内进行监测。

sentences.en: The question on everyone's mind from really the moment this began is just how big a risk is this virus that's quite clearly being passed around the ship.
sentences.zh: 其实从这件事一开始，每个人心里都在想一个问题：这个明显已经在船上传播开来的病毒，到底风险有多大？

sentences.en: So what are these public health officials around the world saying about that risk level?
sentences.zh: 那么，世界各地的这些公共卫生官员是怎么看待这个风险级别的呢？

sentences.en: So immediately, the WHO and everybody else who was actually speaking is very attuned to the fact that we all have post-COVID PTSD, as do some of them, actually.
sentences.zh: 所以，世卫组织和所有实际发言的人立刻就意识到：我们大家——包括他们中的一些人——其实都还有新冠时期的应激创伤（PTSD）。

sentences.en: This is not the start of a COVID pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这不是新冠大流行的开始。

sentences.en: This is an outbreak that we see on a ship.
sentences.zh: 这只是一次在船上发生的疫情暴发。

sentences.en: And they immediately start saying, calm down.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻开始安抚大家，叫大家冷静。

sentences.en: Nothing bad is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 不会有什么坏事发生。

sentences.en: The risk to you is very, very low.
sentences.zh: 对你们来说，风险非常非常低。

sentences.en: This is not the same situation we were in six years ago.
sentences.zh: 这跟我们六年前处境完全不同。

sentences.en: The CDC actually says nothing, really, until May 9th.
sentences.zh: 事实上，直到5月9日，疾控中心基本上什么都没说。

sentences.en: This is America's premier public health agency.
sentences.zh: 这可是美国顶尖的公共卫生机构。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they stayed silent on this matter until...
sentences.zh: 然而直到这时候，他们在这个问题上依然保持沉默……

sentences.en: Despite the fact that there are many Americans on that ship.
sentences.zh: 尽管那艘船上有许多美国人。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that there are Americans on that ship.
sentences.zh: 尽管船上有美国公民。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that American media is carrying news of the ship and these cases and this outbreak.
sentences.zh: 尽管美国媒体一直在报道这艘船、这些病例以及这次疫情。

sentences.en: Nothing from them until May 9th.
sentences.zh: 在5月9日之前，他们毫无作为。

sentences.en: Here with more information is NIH director and acting CDC director, Dr. Jay Bhattacharya.
sentences.zh: 接下来为您带来更多信息的，是美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）局长兼疾控中心（CDC）代理局长杰·巴塔查亚（Jay Bhattacharya）博士。

sentences.en: And then finally, that weekend, Jay Bhattacharya, who is the acting director of the CDC, went on Fox and he went on CNN and he said...
sentences.zh: 然后终于在那个周末，担任疾控中心代理局长的杰·巴塔查亚上了福克斯新闻和CNN，他表示……

sentences.en: Well, I mean, the thing about a cruise is it's close quarters, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，邮轮的特点就是空间狭窄，对吧？

sentences.en: This only spreads when there's close contact.
sentences.zh: 只有在有密切接触时才会传播。

sentences.en: Don't worry.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: Don't worry.
sentences.zh: 不用担心。

sentences.en: You have to be in close contact with someone who has a lot of symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 你必须与出现大量症状的人有密切接触才行。

sentences.en: There have been eight people that have been infected.
sentences.zh: 目前总共只有八人感染。

sentences.en: The first two probably breathed mouse droppings in Argentina.
sentences.zh: 最初的两个人可能是在阿根廷吸入了老鼠的排泄物。

sentences.en: And then people who are very close to them, you know, the roommates, a doctor who was caring for them, they're the ones who got symptomatic.
sentences.zh: 然后是那些与他们非常亲密的人，比如同住一室的室友、照顾他们的医生，这些人才是出现症状的感染者。

sentences.en: He said roommates got infected.
sentences.zh: 他说同住室友被感染了。

sentences.en: That's not true.
sentences.zh: 这并不是真的。

sentences.en: It's not true at all.
sentences.zh: 完全不是事实。

sentences.en: They were in their 80s.
sentences.zh: 他们已经八十多岁了。

sentences.en: Also, he said a couple, they were in their 80s, which is also not true.
sentences.zh: 而且他还说是一对夫妇，他们也已经八十多岁了，这也是假的。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, they died.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，他们去世了。

sentences.en: The problem with that is that the overall message of you don't need to worry is probably accurate.
sentences.zh: 这里的问题在于，“你们无需担心”这一总体传达的信息可能大体上是准确的。

sentences.en: But it's a lot more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 但情况要远比这复杂得多。

sentences.en: We know from previous outbreaks of this virus and even from this current outbreak that it can actually spread even when there isn't close contact.
sentences.zh: 我们从以往该病毒的暴发中，甚至从这次最新的疫情中了解到，即便没有密切接触，它其实也能传播。

sentences.en: And so there was a lot of missing nuance in the communication.
sentences.zh: 所以，在沟通中遗漏了许多微妙而关键的细节。

sentences.en: And it seemed like not just Dr. Patataria and the CDC, but even the WHO, even some of these other health officials were in trying to not get people to panic,
sentences.zh: 看起来不仅是巴塔查亚博士和疾控中心，甚至连世卫组织以及其他一些卫生官员，都在竭力避免引发恐慌，

sentences.en: skimming over all of those and just getting right to this is not a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们对所有这些细节轻描淡写，直奔主题说这不是一场大流行。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们去去就来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露（Winnalou）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块拼字游戏《Connections》的作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“色听觉”的特质（promesthesia）。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时，我会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Apoorva, let's talk about the nuances that have been glossed over so far.
sentences.zh: 那么，阿普尔瓦，我们来聊聊目前被一笔带过的那些细节。

sentences.en: Because in the days since this outbreak began, you've assigned yourself to read all the research on this virus.
sentences.zh: 因为自从疫情暴发以来的这几天里，你一直在阅读关于这种病毒的所有研究资料。

sentences.en: You called a lot of medical experts.
sentences.zh: 你给许多医学专家打了电话。

sentences.en: You've been trying to really objectively understand this virus and its transmissibility and risk.
sentences.zh: 你一直在努力客观地了解这种病毒及其传播能力和风险。

sentences.en: And so, what have you found, and how does that line up with how public health officials have been talking about it?
sentences.zh: 那么，你发现了什么？这与公共卫生官员此前的说法有何吻合或出入？

sentences.en: What you've been hearing from public health experts is very different from how the experts that I've been calling talk about it.
sentences.zh: 你从公共卫生专家那里听到的说法，与我联系的那些专家所描述的非常不同。

sentences.en: One thing that public health officials have been saying over and over is that this virus only spreads through close, sustained contact.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生官员反复强调的一点是，这种病毒只能通过密切、持续的接触传播。

sentences.en: But actually, the best report we have of an outbreak suggests that at least sometimes you don't need close contact.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我们拥有的关于某次疫情的最佳报告表明，至少在某些时候，你并不需要密切接触。

sentences.en: The best characterized outbreak is this outbreak that happened in Argentina in 2018.
sentences.zh: 最具代表性的疫情研究是2018年在阿根廷发生的那次暴发。

sentences.en: And in that outbreak, 34 people got sick and 11 people died.
sentences.zh: 在那次疫情中，34人感染，11人死亡。

sentences.en: But the interesting thing about that outbreak is that it began with one person who got sick from rodents, went to a birthday party when they were feeling sick.
sentences.zh: 但那次疫情有趣的地方在于，它始于一个从老鼠那里感染病毒的人，他在感觉不舒服的时候去参加了一个生日派对。

sentences.en: And he infected five people at that party.
sentences.zh: 他在派对上感染了五个人。

sentences.en: So, at this birthday party, for example, someone got infected just in passing, just passing them saying hello.
sentences.zh: 所以，在这个生日派对上，举个例子，有人仅仅是因为擦肩而过、打了个招呼就被感染了。

sentences.en: Well, a couple of other people got infected sitting at tables at this birthday party near someone who was infected.
sentences.zh: 还有另外几个人是在这个生日派对上坐在某张桌子旁，挨着一个感染者，从而被传染的。

sentences.en: So, there wasn't this close, sustained contact we've been hearing about.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里并不存在我们一直听说的那种“密切、持续的接触”。

sentences.en: So, what you have found suggests a level of transmissibility that involves more casual contacts than what health officials indicated when this latest outbreak began.
sentences.zh: 所以，你的发现表明，该病毒的传播能力涉及更多日常的偶然接触，这超出了卫生官员在最新疫情之初所暗示的程度。

sentences.en: They seem to be suggesting you need pretty intimate, close contact, and what you're describing is not that.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎在暗示你需要相当亲密、密切的接触，而你所描述的情况并非如此。

sentences.en: It's not that.
sentences.zh: 并非如此。

sentences.en: But I do want to be careful to say that we don't think that happens very often.
sentences.zh: 但我还是要谨慎地说明，我们认为这种情况并不经常发生。

sentences.en: I think all of these circumstances have to be just right.
sentences.zh: 我认为必须所有条件都恰到好处才行。

sentences.en: It seems like that only happens when somebody's on the first day of symptoms, for example.
sentences.zh: 看起来只有当某人处于症状出现的头几天时，才会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: And also, in that same study, the people who were sick were being treated by 84 health care workers.
sentences.zh: 此外，在同一项研究中，那些生病的患者由84名医护人员照顾。

sentences.en: None of them got sick, even though many of them weren't wearing the right PPE.
sentences.zh: 他们当中没有一个人感染，尽管其中许多人并没有穿戴正确的个人防护装备（PPE）。

sentences.en: So, it's not necessarily that this virus is spreading really rapidly or really efficiently.
sentences.zh: 因此，这并不一定意味着这种病毒正在极其迅速或非常高效地传播。

sentences.en: It's just that if you have all the right circumstances, it can spread by casual contact.
sentences.zh: 只是说，如果你具备了所有的恰当条件，它确实可以通过偶然接触传播。

sentences.en: Well, let me get a little technical here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我在这里稍微探讨一下专业技术问题。

sentences.en: And I think I learned this from you during COVID.
sentences.zh: 我想我是在新冠疫情期间从你这里学到这个词的。

sentences.en: What is the rate of transmissibility of this virus?
sentences.zh: 这种病毒的传染率是多少？

sentences.en: What is its R-naught?
sentences.zh: 它的基本传染数（R0）是多少？

sentences.en: Very impressed that you still remember this.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你还记得这个。

sentences.en: The R-naught in that outbreak that I just described, where there were those super spreading events, was 2.1, which is not super high.
sentences.zh: 在我刚才描述的那场有超级传播事件的疫情中，R0是2.1，这其实不算特别高。

sentences.en: If you compare that to COVID in the early days, it was probably around 3.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它与疫情早期的奥密克戎或新冠相比，当时大概在3左右。

sentences.en: But as the coronavirus mutated by Omicron, we were talking about an R-naught of 10.
sentences.zh: 但随着冠状病毒变异到奥密克戎阶段，我们讨论的R0达到了10。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: One person who had COVID could basically transmit it to up to 10 other people.
sentences.zh: 一个感染新冠的人基本上可以把病毒传给多达10个人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And measles, we think, has an R-naught of up to 18.
sentences.zh: 而我们认为麻疹的R0甚至高达18。

sentences.en: So, you know, when we look at those very contagious viruses, 2.1 is not crazy high.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，当我们审视那些极具传染性的病毒时，2.1确实算不上疯狂的高。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But at the same time, that last outbreak and this new one strongly suggest a high fatality rate, right?
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，上一次疫情和这次的新疫情，都强烈表明了它具有很高的病死率，对吧？

sentences.en: In that case, it was 34 people infected, 11 dead.
sentences.zh: 在那个案例中，34人感染，11人死亡。

sentences.en: That's about a third, roughly.
sentences.zh: 大约是三分之一的比例。

sentences.en: In this case, you have 11 people infected so far, of which three died, again, about 30%.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，目前有11人感染，其中3人死亡，同样大约是30%。

sentences.en: That's higher than COVID.
sentences.zh: 这比新冠要高。

sentences.en: It's much higher than COVID.
sentences.zh: 比新冠高得多。

sentences.en: And that's partly why some of these public health officials are so worried, because even if it spreads rarely, it is a serious disease.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么其中一些公共卫生官员如此担忧的部分原因，因为即便它很少传播，这也是一种严重的疾病。

sentences.en: It's a severe disease.
sentences.zh: 这是一种重症。

sentences.en: But again, I want to introduce one slight note of uncertainty here, which is we may not know the exact fatality rate for this virus,
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，我想在这里补充一点不确定性，那就是我们可能并不清楚这种病毒的确切病死率，

sentences.en: because if people are infected but don't have symptoms, maybe we've missed some cases in the past, and we've actually overestimated that fatality rate.
sentences.zh: 因为如果有人感染了但没有症状，我们过去可能漏掉了一些病例，从而高估了病死率。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Well, given all of this information, I'm quite curious if health officials around the world were able to locate every one of the boat's passengers
sentences.zh: 好吧，鉴于所有这些信息，我很好奇世界各地的卫生官员是否能够追踪到这艘船上的每一位乘客，

sentences.en: and prevent them from infecting two additional people somewhere out there in the world, and especially those who got off the boat early before it was understood what was happening.
sentences.zh: 并阻止他们在世界上的某个地方再感染另外两个人，尤其是那些在弄清情况之前提前下船的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, they have now figured out who got off the boat and who needs to be monitored.
sentences.zh: 对，他们现在已经搞清楚了谁下了船、谁需要接受监测。

sentences.en: And they're, in fact, also trying to trace the contacts of all those people.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们还在努力追踪所有这些人的密切接触者。

sentences.en: Like, if somebody got off the boat and then flew to Johannesburg and then flew elsewhere, like, who was on that flight?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果有人下船后飞往约翰内斯堡，然后又飞往其他地方——那趟航班上都有谁？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So we should expect to hear more about people being monitored and people getting confirmed positives
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该会听到更多关于人们接受监测以及确诊阳性的消息，

sentences.en: as people go through the full incubation period, which for this virus can be up to eight weeks.
sentences.zh: 随着人们度过完整的潜伏期——对于这种病毒来说，潜伏期最长可达八周。

sentences.en: But for most people, it'll be more like 42 days, six weeks.
sentences.zh: 但对大多数人来说，更可能是42天，也就是六周。

sentences.en: Which is quite long.
sentences.zh: 这时间可真不短。

sentences.en: It's very long for people to have to quarantine or self-isolate or be monitored for symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 对于人们不得不进行检疫、自我隔离或接受症状监测来说，这时间非常漫长。

sentences.en: Does that contact tracing literally involve telling people on a plane, it's possible that you may have sat next to one row back from somebody who is infected with this virus?
sentences.zh: 这种接触者追踪，字面意思是不是包括告诉飞机上的人：你可能坐在感染这种病毒者的后一排？

sentences.en: That is actually what happens.
sentences.zh: 实际情况确实如此。

sentences.en: I believe, actually, they're considering anybody high-risk if somebody sat within two rows, the CDC's guidance, of someone who was on the cruise ship.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，根据疾控中心的指导方针，如果有人坐在邮轮感染者两排座位以内，他们就会被视为高风险人员。

sentences.en: And so they are doing whatever they can to locate everybody who may have come into contact with the passengers on the cruise ship.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们正在尽一切可能找到所有可能与邮轮乘客有过接触的人。

sentences.en: And, of course, the passengers themselves are also being very carefully monitored.
sentences.zh: 当然，乘客本身也正在受到非常仔细的监测。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Speaking of the CDC, what has been its track record of contact tracing in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 说到疾控中心，它在美国境内的接触者追踪记录究竟如何？

sentences.en: specifically?
sentences.zh: 具体来说？

sentences.en: And I ask that because it's not entirely a secret.
sentences.zh: 我这么问是因为这并不是什么秘密。

sentences.en: You've been on the show talking about it.
sentences.zh: 你以前上节目时就谈过这个。

sentences.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）

sentences.en: in the second Trump administration has experienced a tremendous amount of turnover, resignations,
sentences.zh: 在第二届特朗普政府任期内经历了巨大人员流失、辞职潮，

sentences.en: and a real sense of kind of a post-COVID backlash from the folks at the White House who oversee this CDC.
sentences.zh: 并且切实感受到了来自白宫监督该机构的官员们针对新冠疫情的某种强烈反弹。

sentences.en: So how engaged have they been and effective have they been?
sentences.zh: 那么他们的参与度和效率到底如何？

sentences.en: The CDC was never on that ship.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心从来没上过那艘船。

sentences.en: There were officials from the WHO, from the European CDC, from the Dutch health ministry.
sentences.zh: 当时有来自世界卫生组织、欧洲疾病预防控制中心以及荷兰卫生部的官员。

sentences.en: Who made their way onto it.
sentences.zh: 他们登上了这艘船。

sentences.en: Who made their way onto it.
sentences.zh: 他们登上了这艘船。

sentences.en: And who were interviewing the people on the ship, asking about their contacts and so on.
sentences.zh: 并在船上采访了乘客，询问了他们的接触史等情况。

sentences.en: The CDC was not there.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心并不在那里。

sentences.en: The CDC is not really even allowed to talk to the WHO on a regular basis, although they are doing that now during this outbreak, because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心实际上甚至不被允许定期与世卫组织对话，尽管他们在这次疫情期间正在这样做，因为美国

sentences.en: withdrew from the WHO.
sentences.zh: 退出了世卫组织。

sentences.en: And so I actually just spoke to a WHO official who was describing how sad it is that the CDC was not a part of it, because they are the world's experts.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚刚和一位世卫组织官员谈过，他形容疾控中心没有参与其中是多么令人遗憾，因为他们是世界顶尖的专家。

sentences.en: The CDC is a force, this official said.
sentences.zh: 这位官员说，疾控中心是一支不可忽视的力量。

sentences.en: We need them to tell the rest of the world about all the things that go into an outbreak.
sentences.zh: 我们需要他们向世界其他地方介绍爆发疫情时涉及的所有事情。

sentences.en: They were not really engaged until pretty late in the process.
sentences.zh: 直到快到整个过程的后期，他们才真正介入。

sentences.en: And once they did become engaged, how did they do?
sentences.zh: 一旦他们真正介入了，表现又如何呢？

sentences.en: It seems like things are going well now.
sentences.zh: 现在情况似乎进展顺利。

sentences.en: The CDC did go to the Canary Islands, where the boat eventually docked.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心确实去了加那利群岛，这艘船最终在那里靠岸。

sentences.en: And the American passengers were all brought back to the U.S., to Omaha, Nebraska.
sentences.zh: 美国乘客全都被带回了美国内布拉斯加州奥马哈。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We heard from one of the people who's now in quarantine there.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了其中一位目前在那里接受隔离的人。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so they're very closely monitoring the situation now and seem to be extremely engaged.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们现在正非常密切地监控局势，并且显得极其投入。

sentences.en: And if they're engaged now and it's going well, how important is it ultimately that they were a little slow out of the gate?
sentences.zh: 如果他们现在投入而且进展顺利，那么他们最初反应有点慢，到底有多重要呢？

sentences.en: In an outbreak, time is everything.
sentences.zh: 在疫情爆发时，时间就是一切。

sentences.en: We got lucky this time.
sentences.zh: 我们这次很幸运。

sentences.en: It's a cruise ship.
sentences.zh: 这是一艘游轮。

sentences.en: It's not a virus that spreads super easily.
sentences.zh: 它不是那种极易传播的病毒。

sentences.en: But what about next time or the time after that?
sentences.zh: 但下一次或再下一次呢？

sentences.en: If there is a virus that spreads very easily, we're not going to have time to be slow.
sentences.zh: 如果有一种传播力极强的病毒，我们将没有时间慢慢来。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So, Aprova, if we use this outbreak as a case study, and we tend to use all outbreaks in public health as case studies,
sentences.zh: 那么，阿普罗娃，如果我们把这次疫情作为案例研究，而我们在公共卫生领域往往会把所有疫情都作为案例研究，

sentences.en: what do you think officials have learned and not learned in our post-COVID world?
sentences.zh: 你认为在我们的后疫情时代，官员们学到了什么，又没有学到什么？

sentences.en: I think we've learned a lot of technical things.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们学到了很多技术层面的东西。

sentences.en: And I say that not just about the public health officials, but also us, right?
sentences.zh: 我这样说不仅是指公共卫生官员，也包括我们自己，对吧？

sentences.en: Like things like ARNOT.
sentences.zh: 比如基本传染数（R0）之类的东西。

sentences.en: We all have a better understanding of what happens during an outbreak.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都对疫情期间发生的情况有了更好的理解。

sentences.en: And so things like contact tracing and thinking about vaccines and treatments, those, I think, are pretty good.
sentences.zh: 因此，像接触者追踪以及考虑疫苗和治疗方法这些，我认为都相当不错。

sentences.en: But I think where we really have not learned is communication because I still don't really hear public health officials saying enough about what they know and what they don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们真正没有学会的是沟通，因为我仍然听不到公共卫生官员对他们所知道的和不知道的事情说得够多。

sentences.en: What I still hear is them projecting a lot of confidence and wanting to reassure people when actually there's still quite a bit of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 我听到的仍然是他们表现出极大的自信，想要让人安心，而实际上仍然存在相当大的不确定性。

sentences.en: I think overall they're right.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们总体上是对的。

sentences.en: I think this is not a pandemic and we don't need to worry.
sentences.zh: 我认为这不是大流行病，我们不需要担心。

sentences.en: But I think they can still be a lot more honest about all the things that they're still learning about this virus.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，对于他们仍在了解的关于这种病毒的所有事情，他们仍然可以更加坦诚。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in that scenario, perhaps someone from CDC comes out and says, look, we don't think the risk of this ever getting to you is high.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，也许疾控中心会有人站出来说，看，我们认为这病毒波及到你的风险并不高。

sentences.en: We think it's low.
sentences.zh: 我们认为风险很低。

sentences.en: But our original thinking about close contact, we might need to revise that.
sentences.zh: 但我们对密切接触的最初看法，可能需要修正。

sentences.en: We still don't think it's a risk to you, but we are learning new things about this virus.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然认为这对你没有风险，但我们正在了解关于这种病毒的新情况。

sentences.en: You're saying essentially treat us like adults.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，本质上要把我们当成年人对待。

sentences.en: Treat us like adults and tell us that as soon as you find out, you will tell us.
sentences.zh: 把我们当成年人对待，并告诉我们，一旦你们发现情况就会告诉我们。

sentences.en: We have officials now who made it their business, who even became famous by criticizing the CDC for how it did its job before,
sentences.zh: 我们现在有些官员以此为己任，甚至通过批评疾控中心过去的工作方式而出了名，

sentences.en: for saying things like six feet of distance and things like that.
sentences.zh: 比如提出六英尺距离之类的说法。

sentences.en: They criticize the CDC saying there's no evidence for those things.
sentences.zh: 他们批评疾控中心，称这些做法没有证据支撑。

sentences.en: And yet here we are in another outbreak and those people are now in power and they're making some of the same mistakes.
sentences.zh: 然而我们现在又面临一场疫情，那些人现在掌权了，却在犯下同样的错误。

sentences.en: Well, Apoorva, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，阿普罗娃，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 与你交流总是很愉快。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，美国

sentences.en: officials said that they are now monitoring a total of 41 people across the country for Hantavirus symptoms,
sentences.zh: 官员表示，他们目前正在全国范围内监测总共41人的汉坦病毒症状，

sentences.en: including 16 people who traveled on a plane with somebody known to have been infected.
sentences.zh: 其中包括16名曾与已知感染者同乘一架飞机的人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: During a hearing on Thursday, the head of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在周四的一场听证会上，美国

sentences.en: military's Central Command, Brad Cooper, told senators that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 军方中央司令部负责人布拉德·库珀告诉参议员，美国

sentences.en: military had a near perfect record of avoiding civilian casualties in Iran, a claim human rights groups and some lawmakers rejected as not remotely credible.
sentences.zh: 军方在避免伊朗平民伤亡方面有着近乎完美的记录，这一说法遭到人权组织和一些议员的驳斥，认为完全不可信。

sentences.en: So how do you explain the publicly available information that 22 schools have been hit and multiple hospitals?
sentences.zh: 那么，你怎么解释公开的信息显示有22所学校和多所医院遭到袭击？

sentences.en: There's no way that we can corroborate that.
sentences.zh: 我们根本无法证实这一点。

sentences.en: Several senators, including Democrat Kirsten Gillibrand of New York, pressed Cooper on reports, including in The New York Times, that U.S.
sentences.zh: 几位参议员，包括来自纽约州的民主党人吉利布兰德，就《纽约时报》等媒体关于美国

sentences.en: attacks have damaged nearly two dozen Iranian schools and 17 Iranian health care facilities.
sentences.zh: 袭击破坏了近两打伊朗学校和17家伊朗医疗设施的报道向库珀施压。

sentences.en: Have you investigated those claims?
sentences.zh: 你们调查过这些指控吗？

sentences.en: We have not.
sentences.zh: 我们没有。

sentences.en: Why have you not investigated those allegations when they're publicly being made on the cover of The New York Times?
sentences.zh: 既然这些指控已被公开登上《纽约时报》的头版，你们为什么没有进行调查？

sentences.en: And Cuba says it has run out of oil, a dire situation likely to plunge the country into even bigger and longer blackouts.
sentences.zh: 古巴表示其石油已经耗尽，这种可怕的形势很可能会让该国陷入更大、更长时间的停电。

sentences.en: The crisis largely stems from crumbling infrastructure and an energy blockade imposed by the Trump administration, which is seeking political reforms across Cuba.
sentences.zh: 这场危机主要源于基础设施的崩溃以及特朗普政府实施的能源封锁，该封锁旨在推动古巴的政治改革。

sentences.en: Cuba is now without electricity for as many as 22 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 古巴现在每天断电长达22小时。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正为假期的待客之道做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们爱喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何平台上寻找《Wirecutter秀》。
